notes: Azure/Azure Government FedRAMP SSP and continuous monitoring artifacts are accessed via Microsoft Service Trust Portal (STP) under NDA and approval.
Services must be in FedRAMP audit scope for Azure Government for inheritance to be claimed.
evidence_sources: Microsoft Service Trust Portal (FedRAMP reports under NDA)
Azure Government services in FedRAMP audit scope list

notes: In IaaS, Microsoft is responsible for physical datacenter + host infrastructure; customer is responsible for OS/guest configuration, identity configuration, data, applications, and governance.

gating_requirements: Users authenticate via Entra ID (not local-only identities)
MFA enforced for privileged access; ideally for all users in scope
Conditional Access policies configured for the boundary
notes: Entra can support MFA and access policy enforcement, but customer remains responsible for correct tenant configuration and identity lifecycle processes.

gating_requirements: Defender plan enabled for relevant subscription/resources
Recommendations/alerts are reviewed with an operational process
notes: This reduces evidence burden (alerts, recommendations, vulnerability findings) but does not replace governance controls.

gating_requirements: Logs from in-scope resources are collected into a workspace
Alerting rules configured for key events
notes: Customer still must define audited events, enable Windows audit policy, and conduct log review.

gating_requirements: Workloads actually use Key Vault for keys/secrets
Access policies/RBAC are locked down and audited
notes: Key Vault can centralize and harden key/secrets handling; customer still owns key usage decisions and app/OS encryption configuration.

gating_requirements: Restore testing performed on a cadence
notes: Backup services support availability/recovery evidence; restore testing remains customer responsibility.

gating_requirements: Traffic is routed through Azure Firewall (effective enforcement point)
notes: Customer still owns rule design, least privilege, and rule review.

gating_requirements: ExpressRoute circuit provisioned and used for the boundary connectivity
notes: Improves network exposure posture; does not automatically inherit many 800-171 controls by itself.

gating_requirements: NSGs attached to subnets/NICs in scope
Default-deny inbound and restricted egress as applicable

provider_inheritance: FedRAMP High SSP + applicable control implementations (from STP under NDA)
Continuous monitoring reports (from STP under NDA)
Azure Government FedRAMP audit scope for services used
customer_configuration: Tenant/subscription configuration exports (policy assignments, CA policies, Defender plans)
Architectural diagram showing boundary + enforcement points
Procedures (log review, vuln mgmt, backup restore tests)
